verdict.rationale: The evidence shows vault and TOTP access on a computer through the browser extension, which autofills from the vault, and through the full-featured CLI, which returns items and current TOTP codes; `bw serve` also exposes the vault locally. A Linux fingerprint-auth comment indirectly hints at a desktop client, but nothing documents a first-class standalone desktop app. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a dedicated desktop app, evidence of TOTP code display in a desktop app, hands-on corroboration of desktop app quality.
